confidence_notes: Holistic estimates for July 2026. Local meals are more predictable; lodging varies by weekday and season. Cocktail and wine estimates use roughly twice the domestic beer price because direct price knowledge is weaker.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on southern Taiwan secondary-city costs, with Kaohsiung as a rough comparator; Tainan's food and lodging are generally below Taipei, while heritage tourism can raise room prices.
